name: Hot vit lon
summary: Hột vịt lộn is the egg on Con Market’s outdoor list on the 19 Jun 2019 roundup. It is not the stewed plate. Vịt lộn um bầu, with gourd, is the separate order on Ngô Gia Tự.
origin: Named as a Con Market snack. A cooking method for this egg was not printed.
howToEat: The 2019 page names the egg and does not describe a method. Check on arrival. The stew with gourd is a different plate.
where: Outdoor counters at Con Market. The 2019 roundup says that row starts after 15:00. The stewed plate is on Ngô Gia Tự, near Chi Lăng stadium, with no house number.
seoTitle: Hot vit lon — the egg at Con Market
seoDescription: Con Market’s 2019 outdoor list names hột vịt lộn. The stewed balut with gourd is a different plate, on Ngô Gia Tự. Check on arrival.
